question: Does the unknown-world researcher learn every level of cells (1 to 3), and is it replicable?
criterion: (runs) => { const pure = runs.filter((r) => r.lab === 'cells' && r.researcher === 'unknown-world'); const ok = [1, 2, 3].every((l) => pure.filter((r) => r.level === l && r.accepted).length >= 2); return { met: ok, why: ok ? 'every level accepted in at least two runs' : 'some level has fewer than two accepted runs' }; }
